_comment: Copy to targets.json (or pass --targets FILE). A target in this file replaces a built-in preset of the same name. Run `python -m dnsloadforge targets` to see everything that is available.

targets.name: Office DNS filter
targets.notes: A filter in front of your own network: internal names such as corp.local are expected to resolve, and every block category is expected to be blocked.

targets.name: Cloud filter trial (malware + phishing only)
targets.notes: kind=public: NXDOMAIN for internal names is not a failure, and load above 100 qps needs --allow-public-target. 'blocks' lists what this policy should block; the other block categories are still sent but never judged. sinkhole_* are the addresses its block page uses -- find them by querying a known-bad name. These addresses are documentation placeholders (RFC 5737).

targets.name: Unfiltered baseline
targets.notes: blocks=[] means nothing is expected to be blocked: use it as a control to see what an unfiltered resolver looks like on the same traffic.
